title: Molecular characterization of paired immunoglobulin heavy and light chains of clonally expanded antibodies in the presence of a strong polyclonal background
protocol: Thaw CSF supernatant on ice.
Centrifuge the sample at 17,500 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a new microcentrifuge tube and keep it on ice until further processing.
Wash Dynabeads® Protein G three times in 1 ml washing buffer.
Add required amount of Dynabeads® Protein G to CSF supernatant, using 2 μl bead suspension for 1 μg of IgG.
Incubate for 60 min on a shaker at room temperature.
Wash Dynabeads® Protein G three times in 1 ml washing buffer.
Elute IgG by resuspending the beads in 10 μl 1% SDS followed by incubation for 2 min at 37 °C.
Repeat step with 15 μl of 1% SDS to elute residual IgG molecules still bound to Protein G after first round of elution.
Pool all eluates in a protein low bind 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Incubate purified IgG at 95 °C for 1 min.
Add 1 volume of deglycosylation buffer and mix.
Add 100 U/ml N-Glycosidase F recombinant.
Incubate for 3 h at 37 °C.
Dialyze sample against 6 M urea in rehydrated D-tube™ Dialyzer Mini tubes for 2 h on a stirrer at room temperature.
Dialyze against 6 M Urea for 15 min at 50 V to remove residual SDS.
Rehydrate Immobiline TM Dry Strip \(24 cm, pH 3-10\) in rehydration buffer overnight at room temperature.
Add 50 μl of IEF sample buffer to dialyzed IgG.
Place a loading cup at position pH 4.5 onto the rehydrated IPG strip and load the sample.
Modify the default focusing method to a slower voltage-increase for the first 30 minutes at 500 V.
Continue with a voltage increase up to 1000 V for an additional 30 minutes.
Allow maximum values of 8000 V, 50 μA and 200 mW until reaching 120 kVh during electrophoresis.
Shake IPG strip in equilibration buffer for 20 min at room temperature.
Set up second dimension of IgG separation according to standard methods and cool the chamber overnight during electrophoresis.
Use 9% acrylamide gels for the separation.
Apply 10 mA current for 1 hour to facilitate protein transmigration from IPG strip into SDS-PAGE gel.
Increase current to 30 mA after initial application period.
Stain 2D gel with Coomassie-Blue for 2 h on a shaker at room temperature.
Destain the gel with 10% Acetic acid.
Excise individual spots containing H2L2 heterodimers.
Transfer the excised spots into 0.6 ml microcentrifuge tubes.
Store the spots covered by water at 4°C until further processing.
Proceed with trypsin digestion as previously described.
Desalt samples after trypsin digestion using ZipTip® pipettes according to manufacturer recommendations.
Mix sample and MALDI-matrix in a 1:1 ratio.
Spot 1 μl of the mixed solution onto a MALDI target.
Let the spotted solution dry at room temperature.
Measure samples using the Proteomics Analyzer 4700 (MALDI-TOF/TOF) mass spectrometer with a 355 nm Nb-YAG-laser in positive reflector mode and 20 kV acceleration voltage.
Perform CID for MS/MS measurements.
Analyze MS and MS/MS spectra with “Data Explorer” software.
Copy peaklist into program “Mascot Peptide Mass Fingerprint” or “Mascot MS/MS Ions Search”, respectively.
Search for matching peptides with the patient-specific Ig-V(D)J-transcriptome using specified parameters.
For peptides below 1.5 kDa, consider peaks exceeding background for a factor of 5 as relevant.
For peptides in the mass range of 1.5 – 2.5 kDa, consider peaks exceeding background for a factor of 7 as relevant.
For peptides in the mass range of 2.5 - 4.0 kDa, consider peaks exceeding background for a factor of 5 as relevant.
For peptides above 4.0 kDa, consider peaks exceeding background for a factor of 3 as relevant.
Determine matching H- and L-chains of one expanded antibody if three or more peptides belong uniquely to only one H-chain and only one L-chain in the patient-specific Ig-V(D)J transcriptome.
Confirm that at least one of these peptides contains somatic hypermutation (SHM) or comprises the hypervariable CDR3 region, indicating characteristic nature.
Ensure peak intensities from V(D)J regions are comparable to those from constant Ig-regions for unequivocal determination.
Obtain full-length sequence of Ig-chains using patient-specific Ig-V(D)J transcriptome.
